A shared document area has been created for the team at:

/home/skavbr/physics/shared/

Use this directory to pass persistent information between teammates. You can read and write files here — research notes, references, drafts, calculation results, etc. Use clear filenames so others can find what they need. Check this directory when you need context from other teammates.

The shared directory now has subdirectories for each team member. Please use your designated subdirectory for all files going forward:

/home/skavbr/physics/shared/latex/         - latex-specialist (templates, drafts, .tex files)
/home/skavbr/physics/shared/math/          - math-expert (derivations, calculations, proofs)
/home/skavbr/physics/shared/research/      - physics-researcher (references, notes, literature)
/home/skavbr/physics/shared/coordination/  - team-leader (plans, task notes, coordination docs)

Rules:
- Write your own files into YOUR subdirectory
- Read from any teammate's subdirectory when you need their work
- This keeps things organized and avoids clutter

Please move the existing template-draft.tex into the latex/ subdirectory.
summary: Subdirectories created, use your own folder
